## Quality Gate

### Hard floor (required to merge)

- [ ] `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` present
- [ ] `skills/<name>/README.md` present
- [ ] `skills/<name>/LICENSE` present (MIT or Apache 2.0)
- [ ] `skills/<name>/evals/evals.json` present (Anthropic `skill-creator` format), **or** N/A because the skill's output is purely subjective — justified below
- [ ] Ran `skills-qa` — verdict band recorded below
- [ ] If a new skill: added a row to the README "Skills" table

**skills-qa verdict:** <!-- Ready / Some Concern / Material Concerns -->

<!-- If "Some Concern", list the findings and your remediation or justification here.
     "Material Concerns" is not merge-eligible — fix and re-run first. -->

### Gold tier (encouraged, not blocking)

- [ ] Ran the skill against a real document corpus; results in `evals/RESULTS.md`
